name: Spacero: Origins
storyline:
In SPACERO: ORIGINSSpacero: Origins, you begin as a lone pilot in a small starter ship, dropped into a dangerous galaxy with almost nothing.

Your goal is to survive, explore, and grow stronger. You will mine asteroids for resources, collect rare ores, fight hostile ships, discover stations, upgrade your weapons, improve your ship, and push farther into unknown sectors of space.

As you progress, you will encounter different factions, stronger enemies, rare meteors, black holes, hidden opportunities, and powerful bosses guarding the path to new galaxies.

Every run is about building yourself up from a weak ship into a force that can survive the galaxy.

Mine. Fight. Upgrade. Explore. Conquer the stars.
summary:
Spacero: Origins is an exploration driven space adventure focused on discovery, progression, and freedom. Travel across a universe filled with unique civilizations, dangerous enemies, valuable resources, powerful abilities, and colossal galaxy ruling bosses.

Begin your journey with a modest spacecraft and grow into a force capable of crossing entire galaxies. Battle hostile fleets, mine rare resources, earn credits, level up, and continuously improve your ship through upgrades, modules, and advanced technology.

Every galaxy contains its own planets, species, ships, resources, and challenges. As you grow stronger, you will encounter increasingly dangerous civilizations and powerful rulers that control access to the next frontier. Defeat these galaxy bosses to obtain the technology required to travel beyond known space and discover entirely new regions of the universe.
